name: search
description: BM25 keyword search over indexed markdown files. Use specific, rare terms that appear in the documents — avoid common/generic words that dilute ranking. Quote phrases for exact matching (e.g. "decision model"). Semantic/conceptual queries won't work well; prefer precise terminology. Returns ranked results with file paths and surrounding snippets. Use the path with your Read tool to view the relevant section.

query.description: BM25 search query. Prefer specific, rare terms; quote phrases for exact match: "DMN notation"

snippet_size.description: Max characters in the snippet around the match (default 500)
